links.outcome: Flesch Kincaid Grade Level of ChatGPT answers to patient imaging questions versus eighth-grade target
links.effect: Average FKGL 13.6 [CI 12.9-14.2] unprompted, 13.0 [CI 12.41-13.60] prompted (P = .2); no responses reached eighth-grade level.
links.quote: None of the responses reached the eighth-grade readability level recommended for patient-facing materials.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI-generated patient materials relative to recommended level
links.effect: Average FKGL 13.6 [CI, 12.9-14.2] unprompted, unchanged with prompt (13.0, P = .2); none reached eighth-grade level.
links.quote: The average Flesch Kincaid Grade Level was high at 13.6 [CI, 12.9-14.2], unchanged with the prompt (13.0 [CI, 12.41-13.60], P = .2).

links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT responses with versus without a simple prompt
links.effect: Consistency increased from 72% (63 of 88) to 86% (76 of 88) with prompts (P = .02); accuracy did not significantly change (83% vs 87%, P = .2).
links.quote: The consistency of the responses increased from 72% (63 of 88) to 86% (76 of 88) when prompts were given (P = .02).

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT answers to imaging questions rated by radiologists
links.effect: Unprompted responses accurate 83% (218 of 264); prompted 87% (229 of 264; P = .2).
links.quote: Unprompted responses were accurate 83% of the time (218 of 264), which did not significantly change for prompted responses (87% [229 of 264]; P = .2).

unlisted_practices: Adding a short prompt instructing the model to give accurate, easy-to-understand responses to improve relevance and consistency
